SELECT 
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3
FROM 
    customer c
JOIN 
    customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN 
    customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
WHERE 
    ca.ca_state IN ('IL', 'TX', 'ME')
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
        AND store_sales.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM web_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
        AND web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM catalog_sales
        JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
        WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2002 AND date_dim.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
        AND catalog_sales.cs_ship_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    )
GROUP BY 
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY 
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
